definitions: To be in a position where one is likely to be criticised, attacked, or blamed, often due to success or a prominent role.
examples: After winning the championship, the team had a target on their back for the rest of the season.
The new CEO quickly found he had a target on his back from disgruntled employees.
Being the top student meant she always had a target on her back from her rivals.
lemma: have a target on one's back
source: have a target on your back
